overview: Wave Chat is a mobile-first social voice platform inspired by Wakie, with real-time group and private messaging, public and private voice rooms, a shared lobby with themed spaces, user discovery and matching, and robust admin and moderation tools.
features: Real-time direct messaging with pin, delete, emoji reactions, and typing indicators
Themed voice rooms (Music, Chill, Gaming, Rants) each with isolated On Air and Listener sections
Wakie-style lobby with On Air speaker strip and listener grid
User discovery via Matches page filtered by language and online status
Feed with trending posts, language filters, and post sharing/reposting
Activity badges auto-awarded (Active Caller, Top Poster)
Profile visit counter with visitor list
Custom user status presets (Available, Busy, Away, Do Not Disturb)
Online/offline green dot indicator on profiles and calling cards
Admin panel for WILDFIRE with ban, verify, and admin role management
Dark mode with animated themes (Raining, Cloudy, Mountain, Seawave, Waterfalls, Sunny)
WebRTC voice and video calls with floating call banner
